measure: Q=1 independent square-bond percolation on a width-four cylinder, p_horizontal=p_vertical=1/2
state: 14 circular noncrossing partitions of the four frontier vertices; connectivity is through the entire past half-cylinder
matrix_convention: Columns are source states; a full row acts as T=H V. V=product_i (I+D_i(1))/2 first advances the four vertical bonds; H=product_i (I+J_i)/2 then adds the four horizontal bonds of the new row. Products use sites 0,1,2,3; generators within each layer commute.
readout_slice: Immediately after a complete horizontal layer; use the unique stationary probability on frontier states.

readouts.A: AP_0-AP_2 + i(AP_1-AP_3), AP_j=blocks(pi join rooted_adjacent_pair_j); exactly the existing rooted charge-one Gram-derivative columns
readouts.L: landing_0-landing_2 + i(landing_1-landing_3), landing_j=blocks(pi join triple_complement_of_j); exactly the existing landing charge-one columns

target: C_ab(d)=E[O_a(X_0) conjugate(O_b(X_d))]-E[O_a]conjugate(E[O_b]), a,b in (A,L), d=0,...,8. d=0 is a definition baseline, not a new physical independence result.
primary_structure: Compute the exact charge-one restriction of the backward transfer, its characteristic polynomial, and whether the d>=1 response is rank one or two. Preserve the two ordered cross terms.
boundary: Finite width-four square-bond frontier response, not the site-Matching observable, continuum scaling, a physical Jordan identification, or the signed retained-derivative Gram as a probability measure.
acquisition: Exact finite rational arithmetic only; no Monte Carlo or remote machine.
